360° rhythm action

BLOX

One bar through the middle of everything. Blocks fall inward on the beat and you have exactly as long as they take to fall.

Your paddle is a bar straight across the arena. The cyan end follows your cursor, the magenta end trails opposite. A flip hands the live tip to the other end without moving your hand, and later levels split the bar into two or three, so watch which tips are lit.

Block types

  • BlockPut the blade on it
  • HoldRide the ribbon, don’t let go
  • InverseArrives while the magenta tip is live
  • FlickSweep through it, the way the arrows point
  • MineSits close to the blade. Don’t overshoot

Twenty more turn up as you go — each one introduces itself the first time you meet it.

Sharp is native resolution — the crispest the game gets.

Off

The arena renders into a buffer this many times coarser and is blown up with no smoothing. 1 is sharpest. Higher is chunkier and softer, not clearer.
